description: This file defines the 'HealthCheckingActorOptions' class, which encapsulates configuration options for health checking actors, including settings like enabling health checks, check interval, and persistence check parameters.

classes.name: HealthCheckingActorOptions
classes.description: Immutable class holding configuration options for health checking actors, including whether health checks are enabled, the check interval, and persistence check status.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Builder with specified health check enabled flag and interval.

methods.name: isHealthCheckEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether health checking is globally enabled.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for health checks.

methods.name: isPersistenceCheckEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether persistence health checks are enabled.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare configuration option instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code for the options object.

methods.name: toString
